channel.title: Amplitude incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Amplitude's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: We are actively investigating a processing delay in our realtime pipeline [resolved]

item.description:
Incident timeline

Posted Aug 25, 2026 - 14:03 PT

item.title: Login Page Unavailable for New Sign-ins [resolved]
item.description: A fix was deployed, and the issue was fully resolved.

item.title: AI Controls unexpectedly displayed as “Admin preview” [resolved]
item.description: On 2026-08-19 at 10:41:25 AM PT, some customers who had not explicitly enabled AI through the AI Controls page were placed in “Admin preview,” and non-admin users could not access AI features. The issue was fully resolved at 12:41 PM PT on 2026-08-19. No data was impacted, and no customer action is required. Following the fix, customers should now be able to access Global Chat and see the Global Chat interface instead of the “No access” message.

item.title: Delay in realtime data processing [resolved]
item.description: On 2026-08-13 at 7:45 PM PT (2:45 AM UTC on 2026-08-14), we experienced a data ingestion latency. The issue was fully resolved at 8:35 PM PT (3:35 AM UTC on 2026-08-14), and all data has since been recovered. There was no data loss, and no customer action is required.

item.title: We are actively investigating a delay in our pipeline processing [resolved]
Intermittent Connectivity Issues [resolved]
item.description:
Between approximately 2026-07-24 03:39–05:00 PT (10:39–12:00 UTC), some customers may have experienced intermittent connectivity issues while accessing Amplitude or sending data, including connection timeouts. This was caused by an AWS networking disruption in the us-west-2 region affecting multiple upstream AWS services.
The issue originated outside of Amplitude's infrastructure and was resolved by AWS.
Services: - Our SDKs queue undelivered events on-device and automatically retry sending them, so we expect minimal to no data loss from this incident. No ingested data was lost and no action is required. - Experiment/Flag evaluations failed and return 503s due to service unavailability. There is no data loss.

item.title: We are actively investigating bigquery exports taking a long time to complete [resolved]
Some users may have experienced errors when accessing Amplitude. [resolved]
item.description:
We identified the source of the issue and rolled back the responsible change at 12:06 PM PT (19:06 UTC). Error rates have returned to normal, and we are actively monitoring to confirm full stability.
There is no data loss. No customer action is needed at this time.

item.title: Amplitude UI and MCP is down [resolved]
Custom Metrics – Metric Details Page Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and the Custom Metrics metrics details page displays normally now.

item.title: Slow Loading for Web App Features in the EU Region [resolved]
Shared Embeds and Public Links Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This incident is resolved. Shared embeds and public links have been stable since 1:50 AM PT (08:50 UTC), and we have verified affected links render normally. A permanent fix ships later today. No data was lost and no customer action is needed.

item.title: Data Processing Delayed [resolved]
item.description: All systems are caught up and functioning normally.

item.title: Delay in processing data in our realtime pipeline [resolved]
Amplitude Platform Unavailability [resolved]
item.description:
Service has been restored for the Amplitude application, and users should now be able to access the application normally.
We have implemented a fix and are monitoring the system to ensure continued stability. We do not expect any data loss at this time.
Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Amplitude Platform Unavailability [resolved]
item.description:
We have resolved the issue affecting the Amplitude application, and services are operating normally again.
We do not expect any data loss as a result of this incident. Our team will continue to monitor the system to ensure stability.
Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Application Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description: The issue causing elevated application latency has been resolved. We have confirmed that system performance has returned to normal levels and continue to monitor closely to ensure ongoing stability.

item.title: Ingestion lag in our batch pipeline [resolved]
Amplitude web application not loading [resolved]
item.description: The Amplitude web application in the US was briefly inaccessible. We identified the issue to be related to a misconfigured feature flag. The issue started at 10:00 AM PST, lasting 10 minutes, and is now resolved.
